title: Hancock's ayahuasca alien abduction vision

tellings.quote: then I saw not one but several flying saucers up above me and I saw this characteristic alien face you know this sort of heart-shaped large dark eyes

plain: The writer Graham Hancock says that in 2003, after drinking ayahuasca, an Amazonian hallucinogenic brew, outside a shaman's hut in the Amazon, he saw "not one but several flying saucers" above him and the familiar alien face, "heart-shaped," with "large dark eyes," in what felt like an abduction. He tells Michels this first-hand. He raises it because it echoes reports of alien abduction, suggesting such encounters may touch the same reality that these plants open.
